# Runflix Entertainment

> A modern movie, TV series, and anime discovery platform.

## About
Runflix Entertainment is a content discovery and streaming aggregation platform built with React, Vite, TailwindCSS, and the GiftedTech Movies API.

## Features
- Movie and TV series discovery
- Trending content browsing
- Real-time search with pagination
- Detailed movie and series information
- Episode and season exploration
- Multi-quality downloads with subtitles
